newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends sharply lower on commercials, fund.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends sharply lower on commercials, fund.

text.p: WCE canola futures closed sharply lower after tumbling to new contract lows in all months on commercial, hedge and fund selling, traders said.

"Commercials sold, there were hedges and some light fund selling in November through the session," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -3.74 Wednesday from +0.03 Monday. July-Aug spread $7.70, July-Oct $4.20, Aug-Nov $13.50.

July ended down C$12 at $361 after setting a new low of $358.80. August closed $12.90 lower at $352.90 after falling the expanded $15 limit to a new low of $350.80. Declines in November were more muted, with that contract ending $8.40 lower at $339.20 after notching a low of $338.50.

July flax fell $4 to $325.70 with UGG buying late after it set a new low of $322, November fell $5.70 to $286.50 after it set a new low of $284 on commercial selling and hedges. RBC-DS bought 100 July-Sep at $30. New lows were set in all months.

July western barley fell $1.60 to a new low of $120.50 on long liquidation and October ended $1.60 lower at $125 after it set a low of $124.90 on hedges. Alberta Wheat Pool sold 300 July Oct at $4.20 to UGG, traders said. Lows were set in all months.
July feed wheat ended unchanged at $149 after posting a new low of $147.60 on liquidation. October finished off $0.20 at $153.10 after a new low of $151.80. New lows were set in all months.
RBC bought five October oat contracts unchanged at US$107. Peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas.)
